head: Google Flow, Google's AI image and video studio, climbs the App Store
dek: Google Flow lets you create and edit images and videos with Google's AI models on your phone, starting from your camera roll or the live camera. It was #3 in Graphics & Design among free apps on the US App Store on 3 November.
details: Projects sync with Flow on the desktop through one shared library. The app is free to download with in-app purchases, made by Google.
means: If you make AI images or short videos, you can now do it from your phone with Google's own app.
todo: Find Google Flow in the App Store; check the in-app purchases before you buy anything.
